notes: Access: curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131, ~5-8s pacing; one 429/px-captcha on a first URL-guess attempt cleared on retry after longer backoff (transient PerimeterX challenge, not a persistent block -- surrounding requests to the same host succeeded before and after). Discovery: no 'Clearance'/'Outlet'/'Final Sale'/'Closeout' link found in the SSR mega-nav JSON (which does expose full header taxonomy including a 'Sale' item -> https://www.jossandmain.com/m/shop-sale). Checked seo-category-sitemap~0.xml (166 URLs) and all 3 seo-keyword-sitemap shards (~104k URLs combined) for clearance/outlet/closeout/final-sale/last-chance slugs -- zero matches. Ran the site's own internal search (/keyword.php?keyword=clearance): this did NOT return a generic mixed search-results grid -- it rendered a full merchandising-event page (H1 "Closeout", a single 'Closeout' facet auto-selected, BlockBuilderBrowseTitleEvent/BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount blocks, browsePageType:3 -- the identical page architecture used by this project's validated Best Sellers/New Arrivals PLPs on this same site), with visible '252 Items', browseResultCount=252 and totalSKUCount=252. Confirmed this has its own stable canonical URL following the site's normal /curated/<slug>~ev<eventId>.html pattern: https://www.jossandmain.com/curated/closeout~ev1.html (eventId=1, fetched directly and independently, same 252-item content) -- recorded that URL rather than the keyword.php search URL. This page is not linked from any visible header/footer nav; it was found via search + URL-pattern confirmation only. CLEARANCE VS SALE reasoning: 'Closeout' is treated as a genuine Clearance-taxonomy synonym (discontinued/permanently-marked-down stock being sold off), distinct from the site's '/m/shop-sale' hub, which was opened separately and found to be a pure BlockBuilderCuratedNavigation hub (no BrowseGrid, no product/result count of its own) linking out to ~10+ named, time-boxed '/daily-sales/...' campaign pages (e.g. 'Natural Hardwoods', 'All-Weather', 'Top-Rated Patio Furniture', 'In-Stock & Ready-to-Ship Furniture', 'Best-Selling Furniture') -- excluded per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test as generic temporary promotions, and also robots.txt-disallowed (Disallow: /daily-sales/*.html) so not crawled. Joss & Main is Wayfair-family (Next.js/BlockBuilderBrowse); its Clearance-equivalent concept is named 'Closeout' and is reachable only via search + curated-URL-pattern guessing rather than main nav -- worth checking the same 'Closeout'/keyword-redirect trick on AllModern/Birch Lane (also in this batch, same platform) if their own nav doesn't surface a Clearance link either.
